what: A third actor (anonymous SYSTEM actor PaymentGateway) makes the generated admin frontend build fail at pnpm run format (biome: duplicate identifiers in one import declaration, e.g. import type { CsvFile, CsvFile, ... }). Gone when the actor is removed. The builder dropped the anonymous webhook and used a bearer-token call to the Admin actor plus an HMAC signature instead.
why: Generator bug in the admin frontend template helper (getApiImportsForPage / classDataName returns the type twice); contradicts the catalog's anonymous-actor guidance for public entry points.
workaround: Removed the anonymous actor; F72 webhook is a static operation called with the Admin bearer token plus HMAC signature (GAPS R16-4).
proposed_target: judo generator: ui-react admin frontend import generation (duplicate type imports)

what: Plain build without -i fails on every generated frontend file because the frontend build itself reformats generated code; the REVIEW-R16 advice to build without -i was wrong, and build -i leaves the checksum file empty.
why: Build reformats generated files, so a later generate reports manual changes; the catalog does not state that -i is required for the round cycle.
workaround: Always run ./judo.sh build -f -i (and generate -i) in the round scripts.

what: judo.sh build -a and build -F -KA update ~/.m2 but not application/.karaf/system, so a later start runs stale jars and shows Missing SDK operations. Only a full build fixes it.
why: Build targets write to different locations than the runtime reads; not documented in the help text.
workaround: Full build (build -f -i or full build) after backend changes before starting Karaf.

what: The generated admin UI never sends __version, so two admins editing the same product silently overwrite each other (stock 11 became 7). Optimistic locking does not protect UI edits.
why: Generated admin edit form omits the version member; catalog says clients echo __version but the generated UI does not.
workaround: Added ProductConflictInterceptor that refuses a stale save with a 422 CONFLICT.
proposed_target: judo generator: admin UI edit payload should echo __version

what: No catalog recipe for a partial update with optimistic locking: the mask only shapes the read-back, the write still needs the version in the payload, and a stale version must be re-read and retried.
why: data-access-guide Pattern 4 (Partial Updates) does not say that the mask does not limit the write nor how to combine it with __version.
workaround: StockService writes only identifier, version, stock and soldUnits, re-reads on stale version, and returns NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK when stock is gone.

what: Earlier Playwright specs (levels 3, 4, 5) fail in 10 of 24 tests: the admin Products table shows 10 rows per page in database order and there are now about 150 products, so unfiltered lookups by name (adminReadStock, addFromCard, gridcell by name) and waits on the ~get response do not find their rows. The level 4 menu-order test also expects the menu from before round 15.
why: Shared dev database grew with seller and test data; the helpers do not filter or page; no cleanup or per-test prefix.
workaround: None in this round; GAPS notes it. Suggested: filter by name in helpers, prefix test data, cleanup.

what: Level 9a checkout failed: the digits of the typed address (Lake Road 9, 5003) landed in the Loyalty points to spend field, which has focus when the checkout dialog opens (the field showed 95,003), so the order was refused and the helper got no order number.
why: Generated checkout dialog starts with focus in the loyalty points field; the spec did not clear it (level 8 did).
workaround: openCheckout in level9a clears the points field and blurs it before the address and checkout; the helper waits for the field to be empty.
proposed_target: judo generator: checkout dialog initial focus

what: Level 7 and the overhaul spec fail at random steps in some long runs (screenshot timeout, lookups not found, checkout response null), and pass when run alone (level 7 7 of 7, overhaul 2 of 2). Not proven to be caused by the checkout change.
why: Load-dependent: slow pages after checkout under a long session; no old build to compare.
workaround: Re-ran alone; GAPS records it as load-dependent flakiness.

what: kb_get on a path without a section returns only the first section and a count of further sections; reading a whole blueprint needs one call per section.
why: Tool returns one section per call for path-only fetches; the agent then has to guess section names.
workaround: Fetched backend.md once, got only the first section, then moved on.
proposed_target: kb_get (return all sections or a section index for path-only fetches)

what: kb_get with a section heading returns only a keyword line or the intro blurb for root sections, not the practice body (correlation-based-event-chaining, reservation-booking-entity Intent).
why: Root sections of best practices and blueprints index only the metadata chunk; the body is in later sections.
workaround: Read catalog files from disk (see c13-11) or use kb_search with other terms.

what: After kb_get returned only blurbs, the agent read catalog files from disk with cat and ctx_execute (cards blueprint, custom-visual-element-override, advanced-patterns, the four custom blueprints).
why: kb did not give the section bodies (same cause as c13-10 and c13-09), so the kb-first rule was broken for the R16U design step.
workaround: Read the catalog on disk under catalog/ and logged it in the round notes.

what: The kb read guard injected a notice about repeated source searching about 30 times during build and test debugging, where no kb entry could answer the question (Playwright logs, Karaf logs, DB queries).
why: Guard counts consecutive non-kb tool calls; debugging a test run is mostly non-catalog work, so the guard fires on normal work.
workaround: Ignored the notice and kept debugging; ran kb_search only for catalog questions.

what: Customer order detail custom layout showed 0 order lines in the DOM while the database had 3 lines for order WS-2026-000311.
why: Not established; the lines are a relation table inside the order view, and the check was done with a wrong DB column name first.
workaround: None yet; investigation left open at the end of the chunk.

what: The generated cards container toolbar is an empty stub (DefaultToolbar renders an empty div), and a cards container shows no table operations, no loading state and no empty state, so the builder wrote its own toolbar and action bar.
why: Generator ships a placeholder default toolbar; the catalog cards blueprint does not say the toolbar must be replaced.
workaround: Wrote shared ListBars (toolbar and action bar) and ShopCard components, registered via the cards configuration hook.

what: custom-post-detail-views says a custom view replaces the default container layout, but the mechanism is one custom implementation element per field of the view; the whole view cannot be replaced, so every field needs a model mark and a register call.
why: Catalog describes a whole-view replacement that the platform does not offer; the implementation pattern in the blueprint is the per-element route.
workaround: Marked all fields of the detail views as custom implementation; first element renders the whole summary layout, others render nothing.

what: judo CLI graphql rejects where name in [...] on StringFilter (the valid operators listed are contains, endsWith, eq, icontains, iendsWith, iregex, istartsWith, regex, startsWith).
why: StringFilter has no in operator in this CLI version.
workaround: Queried actor types with limit and filtered in Python.

what: target/judo-cli.jar disappears after a frontend build (build -f -i) and is missing again later; judo update commands fail with Unable to access jarfile until generate-root recreates it.
why: Not stated; build or generate-root removes or does not recreate the CLI jar.
workaround: Ran ./judo.sh generate-root, which recreated target/judo-cli.jar.

what: Builder found that the graphql view shows representationComponent null for TransferObjectTable (for example ShopProductInfo Product_Table) while relation TabularReferenceFields carry table; setting representationComponent=card on a TransferObjectTable with update works.
why: Attribute is documented on TransferObjectTable in ui.md, but the query did not show it, so the builder relied on the update result.
workaround: Used update ... --set representationComponent=card and checked with status.

what: Pointing the Vite dev server at the Karaf backend needs VITE_API_DEFAULT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8181; the app uses hash routes (#/Customer/...), so direct path URLs do not open the screen. The builder found both by reading main.tsx, after the kb guard fired.
why: Dev-server setup for HMR is not in the catalog path the builder read (development-workflow).
workaround: Started npx vite with VITE_API_DEFAULT_BASE_URL set and added playwright.dev.config.ts (local override) to target it.
proposed_target: catalog/agent-docs/frontend/development-workflow.md (Vite dev server against a Karaf backend)

what: Browser CLI find actions failed: find role button --name Products click and find text MY ACCOUNT click are not valid; only click, fill, check, hover and text are accepted.
why: Agent-browser syntax used from memory.
workaround: Used snapshot -i refs and clicked by ref, or opened the URL directly.

what: Look spec failed in the dev run: clickMenu Quotes not found for customer1 (no company), and My returns was detached during a re-render (HMR) so the click failed.
why: Spec assumed menu entries that the test user does not have; no wait for the menu to settle.
workaround: Removed Quotes from the look list and added an order-detail screenshot step.

what: Builder guessed names several times: a wrong repo path for the catalog (model-blueprints under the repo root, not catalog/), wrong DB column names (c.c_id, o.c_customer, c_order_id), and ctx_execute was given a timeout field it does not accept (it takes timeoutMs).
why: Names recalled from memory instead of checked with ls or the schema.
workaround: Corrected each call after the error.

what: Shell and Python slips: GNU sed -i syntax on macOS (needs sed -i with an empty suffix), the timeout command does not exist on macOS, and a Python 3.9 f-string with a backslash broke the detail-hook generator, so registerDetailLayouts was missing and tsgo reported TS2307.
why: Environment differences (macOS BSD tools, Python 3.9) not checked before the script ran.
workaround: Used sed -i '' and fixed the generator script; reran tsgo.

what: Customer lists become card containers: 22 cards configuration hooks registered (product list, orders, returns, returnable items, notifications, addresses, company members and invitations, quotes, sub-orders, wallet gift cards and points, seller entries, reviews, exchange rates), with a shared ShopCard, status colour map, ListBars toolbar and ProductCard at 4:3 image ratio.
why: One consistent look across the customer app, and generated paging and data loading stay in the generated container.

what: Model changes for R16U: representationComponent=card on about 12 TransferObjectTables (orders, returns, returnable items, notifications, addresses, quotes, seller products, sub-orders, exchange rates, admin orders, admin returns, admin quotes) and on relation tables (wallet gift cards and points, and others), rowsPerPage 12, and customImplementation=true on 93 view fields; validate then save, then generate and build -f -i.
why: Cards need the table representation set, and the custom elements need the model mark before generation.

what: Detail screens (orders, quotes, sub-orders, returns, wallet, seller, company, notifications) get one summary layout (DetailLayout with detailSpecs) rendered by the first custom element of each view; the other fields render nothing, and a GlobalStyles rule hides their empty grid cells.
why: Keeps the generated view page (title, back, actions, relation cards) and gives a summary header with sections.

what: Payment provider: PaymentAdapter with stub (succeed, fail, timeout without sleeping) and HTTP adapter, chosen by the Shop settings Payment provider setting; Pay now on the order; a decline or timeout leaves the order NEW with a Payment problem and a history row.

Payment webhook as static operation PaymentGatewayInfo.receive with HMAC signature; idempotency key is the event id stored on the order; repeated events write no second history row. Called with the Admin bearer token (see c13-01).

Stock reservation at checkout for the Stock reservation (minutes) setting (15 by default); paying consumes the reservation; an unpaid order is cancelled and its stock returned; clock passed as a parameter; executor job every minute; admin button Release expired reservations with a Minutes input.

StockService: one write with identifier, version, stock and soldUnits only; on a stale version it re-reads, repeats if enough stock is left, else NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK with the real stock. Checkout uses it, which removes the 500 on concurrent update (R16-R2) and gives the last-item race fix.
ProductConflictInterceptor refuses a stale product save with a readable 422 CONFLICT (two admins case).

Shop home and product list: shared ProductCard with ImagePlaceholder (4:3), CatalogHome grid uses it; ProductListCard registered for the Products list container; both use the same CARD_CELL grid (1, 2, 3 columns).

Admin dashboard custom elements found in the model (DashboardInfo_View_Edit ordersToday and revenueToday) already exist in webshop__admin/src/custom; the builder read them as the start point for an admin figures card. No admin card converted within this chunk.
